card.name: Scattered words in citations and drug lists
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on assorted words in references, scripture quotes, URLs and drug-name lists, often just before a name, number or code continues.

modes.label: Citation and reference pieces
modes.description: Parts of journal citations, page ranges, URLs and organization names.
modes.example: in the UK in 2010. Br J Cancer, 2011. 106 (S2) p.<< S>>14- S18. PubMed

modes.label: Inside drug salt names
modes.description: Middle of a capitalized drug-name list like amphetamine sulfate.
modes.example: DEXTROAMPHETAMINE SACCHARATE, AMPHETAMINE ASPARTATE, DEXTROAMPHETAMINE S<<UL>>FATE AND AMPHETAMINE

modes.label: Quoted scripture or prose
modes.description: Ordinary words inside quoted or biblical sentences.
modes.example: So the priest shall make atonement for them, and it<< shall>> be forgiven them.
